summary: First-party local evidence establishes Chizhou Natural Resources and Planning Bureau / Chizhou Real-Estate Registration Center custody and lists a city GIS public-service platform. Anonymous inspection did not verify a public parcel feature service, schema, CRS, native parcel ID, or geometry, so no GeoJSON sample is retained and runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Chinese discovery queries, outcomes, and actual URLs are recorded in city-11232-chizhou.json.

requestOutcomes.outcome: HTTP page retrieved. The official sitemap lists the Chizhou Geospatial Information Public Service Platform at http://cztdt.chizhou.gov.cn/chizhou/ and an immovable-property registration section.
HTTP page retrieved. The official map section exposes standard-map raster/EPS downloads and city/district map pages, not a parcel vector service.
HTTP page retrieved. Page JavaScript exposed image and EPS/TIF download paths for a standard administrative map; no parcel IDs, schema, CRS, or vector geometry were present.
HTTP response was 403 Forbidden (Access not allowed). No login, CAPTCHA bypass, credential, private token, or retry through an alternate identity was used.
Connection failed after a bounded request timeout; no service configuration, API endpoint, schema, CRS, or geometry response was obtained.
Connection timed out after a bounded 20-second request. No registration query or parcel request was issued.

Official project document was identified in discovery; it describes collecting and consolidating cadastral survey and registered-parcel graphic data during 2026, but provides no anonymous parcel download endpoint.

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point [30.6581046077459, 117.478427069436] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted.
Local custodial evidence and a listed GIS platform do not prove an open vector parcel API or citywide public coverage.
No parcel schema, CRS, stable native parcel identity, geometry response, or citywide geometry coverage was verified.
The 403, timeout, and inaccessible public platform are recorded as route limitations, not evidence of cadastral absence.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, personal, or unsafe registration fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is research bookkeeping only and does not qualify or admit a runtime adapter; serial reviewer qualification remains required.
